maria: FYI — EU healthcare pilot just asked for 7y audit retention + reversible pseudonymization for PHI. They also want BYOK and an auditable legal-hold flow. Need to decide launch gating and implementation approach. :thinking_face:
jonathan: 7y is a long tail. operationally we should split what we retain: minimal event metadata long-term, full payload short-term. pseudonymize identifiers with a tokenization layer. saves cost and reduces exposure. :+1:
priya: Legal/security: reversible tokenization is acceptable only if the decryption key is customer-controlled (BYOK). SOC2 auditors will want chain-of-custody for any re-identification events and proof of HSM-backed key management.
diego: Implementation constraints: per-tenant HSM in hosted product is hard. options:
  1) BYOK with envelope keys: customer KMS -> our envelope keys -> storage. cheaper but more complex to roll out.
  2) Dedicated/key-isolation pool for healthcare customers (Dedicated or Private only).
We can also offer a partner cold-archive for immutable 7y storage to reduce live-store costs.
priya: Also: we need a documented "legal-hold snapshot" procedure: one-click snapshot + immutable archive + signed audit record. auditors will test retrieval and proofs.
maria: Draft launch criteria (proposal):
  - per-tenant KMS mode available (customer-managed keys)
  - configurable retention policy with default two-tier window (metadata 7y, payload 90d)
  - reversible tokenization gated by customer key mode + consent flag
  - legal-hold snapshot exports with signed chain-of-custody artifacts
  - SOC2 evidence: test harness for export + reviewer checklist
  - cost/ops runbook and SRE oncall escalation for long-tail restores
jonathan: cost note: 7y immutability in hot storage will be expensive. recommend cold-tier + retrieval SLA (e.g., 24-72h) for restores unless customer pays for hot-retention.
diego: quick config example for product API (ops format):

``
retention:
  audit_events: 7y
  event_payload: 90d
  legal_hold_enabled: true
kms:
  mode: customer_managed
  rotation_window_days: 90
tokenization:
  reversible: true
  key_source: customer_kms
``

priya: Also add acceptance test: simulate a legal hold, run export, verify signature timestamps and HSM attestation. auditors will expect stable results across regions.
maria: ok. action items:
  - product: write detailed gating checklist and PRD (maria) — due EOD Fri
  - eng: spike envelope-key BYOK + cold-archive pattern (diego, jonathan) — 2wk spike
  - security: draft legal-hold export spec + acceptance tests (priya) — next Tue
  - ops: estimate S3/archival cost for 7y per TB and escalation runbook (sre) — next Wed

sre-bot: Incident note: scheduled maintenance for archival tier import pipeline tonight 02:00 UTC. May affect test restores. :warning:
jonathan: thanks — will coordinate around the maintenance window for the spike.
maria: perfect. we'll reconvene after spikes and have an exec-facing risk/cost slide by next week. :rocket:
